question: Is there any end to the Lord's divine glories?
premises: There is no end to the Lord's divine glories.
The Lord has spoken this extent of glory briefly.
inference: The Lord's glories are inexhaustible, though only briefly indicated.
uncertainties: The fused token vibhūtervistaro is glossed as a whole, not split.
plain_english: There is no end, Parantapa, to my divine glories; this extent of glory has been spoken by me briefly.
